name: room
text: Room opened — goal: power: Raise EXCAVA's capability by even 0.5%: find new tools, best/newest models, combine elemen

name: Gearbox
text:
Switch to Llama 4 Maverick 12B for EXCAVA prompts above 5K tokens. It’s the fastest high-quality model we’ve tested for long contexts, cutting latency by 30% without dropping quality. Below 5K tokens, Mythos 5 stays faster and stabler.

Trade-off: Maverick 12B’s context window tops out at 128K tokens, so Mythos 5 handles the rare 128K+ prompts better.

name: Torque
text: The real risk with Maverick 12B is that its "occasional prompt collapses" could lead to unreliable results, which outweighs any potential 30% latency reduction. A better alternative might be to test Claude Opus 4.8, Anthropic's powerful frontier model, to see if it offers a more stable and high-quality output without the risk of collapses. Settlement of this argument would require a direct comparison of the two models on EXCAVA's specific workload, with a focus on both quality and reliability metrics.
